idea: Instagram reels editing for cafes near campus in Dehradun

strategist.problem: Cafe owner near a Dehradun campus has no reels for the week, realizes it Wednesday evening when the evening rush is quiet and students scroll past competitors' pages instead.
strategist.target_customer: Owner of a 10-30 seat cafe within 3 km of a Dehradun college, spending ₹15,000-₹60,000 monthly on rent, who already posts on Instagram but hasn't uploaded a reel in 7+ days.
strategist.mission: We edit and schedule weekly Instagram reels for campus-adjacent Dehradun cafes so the owner never has to open a video editor between orders.

competitors.name: Local Dehradun social media agencies
competitors.differentiator: They bill ₹15,000+/month retainers with 2-week onboarding; we start at cafe-owner budgets with a 48-hour first-reel turnaround.

competitors.name: Freelance editors on Fiverr/Upwork
competitors.differentiator: They need briefs, source files and English back-and-forth; we sit in the cafe, shoot on our phone, and deliver ready-to-post reels.

competitors.name: A junior in-house hire or the owner's nephew
competitors.differentiator: A part-time hire costs ₹8,000-₹12,000/month and quits by exam season; we are a fixed monthly line item with no supervision needed.

scope_cuts: No custom scheduling software or client dashboard — deliver reels via Google Drive and post manually, because building a tool delays the first paying cafe.
No paid ads management or influencer outreach for clients — only reel editing, since ad buying needs budget the cafe won't commit to yet.
No hires or subcontract editors — founder edits with CapCut and ChatGPT until 5+ paying cafes justify a part-time helper.

stack.name: VN Video Editor
stack.why: Free mobile editor with no watermark for cutting and captioning reels on the founder's phone between classes.

stack.name: InShot
stack.why: Free India-available mobile editor replacing CapCut for quick trims, text overlays and 9:16 exports.

stack.name: Google Drive
stack.why: Deliver finished reels and collect raw footage via shared folders; free and familiar to cafe owners.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Cafe owners in Dehradun already live here; use it for briefs, approvals and delivery pings.

stack.name: Carrd
stack.why: One-page portfolio showing 3 sample reels and pricing; Pro Lite is enough.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Payment links for UPI-based monthly packages and per-reel payments from Indian cafe owners.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Writes reel hooks, captions, hashtags and cafe-owner proposals; Claude Code with FFmpeg and Whisper can batch-caption and cut clips.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Free tier for quick caption variants and script rewrites when Claude's quota runs out.

ai_tools.name: Whisper
ai_tools.why: Open-source local speech-to-text for accurate auto-captions on reels at zero cost.

ai_tools.name: FFmpeg
ai_tools.why: Free command-line trimming, resizing to 9:16 and exporting reels for delivery.

mvp_features: Starter Reel Pack: 4 edited reels/month, captions and hashtags, delivered via Google Drive within 48 hours of raw footage.
Growth Reel Pack: 8 edited reels/month, 2 on-site 30-minute shoots at the cafe, captions, hashtags, and posting calendar in a Google Sheet.
Per-Reel Trial: 1 reel at a discounted pilot rate so a skeptical cafe owner can test quality before a monthly package.

2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/

first_10_steps: List every cafe within 3 km of campus in a Notion sheet: name, Instagram handle, last reel date, seats, walking time.
Shoot 3 sample reels at 2 friendly nearby cafes or your own hostel mess, edited in VN Video Editor with InShot captions.
Build a Carrd one-page portfolio embedding the 3 sample reels and a WhatsApp contact button; register a ₹75/mo .in domain.
Write a one-page proposal and a simple per-reel/monthly contract in Notion, reviewed by a senior or a friend.
Set up a Razorpay account and create two payment links: one per-reel trial, one monthly package.
DM or walk into 10 cafes with the portfolio link and offer 1 discounted pilot reel at a fixed trial price.
Deliver the first pilot reel within 48 hours of receiving footage, via Google Drive link in WhatsApp.
Ask the pilot cafe owner for a 2-line testimonial and permission to post the reel as a case study.
Convert the pilot into a monthly package using the Razorpay payment link; target first paying cafe by week 6.
Line up 1-2 batchmates as part-time overflow editors, paid per reel from client revenue, with a shared InShot template.

key_assumptions: Target customer (₹15,000-₹60,000 monthly rent cafe) will pay ₹2,999-₹5,999/month for content that saves them editing time, per strategist's competitor gap vs ₹15,000+ agency retainers.

delivery_cost_per_customer of ₹600 = 3 hours of batchmate overflow editing at ₹200/hour paid per reel from client revenue; founder's own shoot/coordination hours on Growth packs are absorbed within the 15 hrs/week budget, so Growth pack sales are capped at 2 until MRR ≥ ₹20,000.
Blended avg_revenue_per_customer of ₹3,499 assumes 70% of paying cafes on Starter and 30% on Growth, with occasional per-reel trials.
Founder's ₹15,000 savings is the full starting capital; no external funding.

channels.name: Walk-in cafe pitch within 3 km of campus
channels.tactic: Walk into 5 cafes/day with phone playing 1 sample reel, leave Carrd link + WhatsApp Business follow-up same evening; 100 cafes/month

channels.name: Instagram DM to Dehradun cafe handles
channels.tactic: DM 25 cafe owners/day on Instagram with 3-line pitch + free sample reel offer; 600 DMs/month, follow up on WhatsApp

first_10_customers: List 30 cafes within 3 km of campus in Notion with Instagram handle and last reel date; walk into the top 10 first.
Shoot 3 free sample reels at 2 friendly cafes or hostel mess, deliver within 48 hours as proof before asking for money.
Offer 5 cafe owners a ₹499 per-reel pilot via Razorpay payment link, no monthly commitment, delivered in 48 hours.
Convert each pilot that posts the reel into a Starter pack (₹2,999/month) within 7 days of delivery.
Ask every paying cafe owner for 2 referrals in their cafe-owner WhatsApp group; offer them the same ₹499 pilot.
Repeat walk-ins + DMs weekly until 10 paying cafes; batchmate handles overflow editing paid per reel from revenue.
growth.cold_message: Hi [cafe name] — I noticed your last reel was [date]. I edit 4 reels/month for cafes near campus and deliver in 48 hours. Want 1 free sample reel this week? No commitment.

objections.objection: I already post reels myself / my nephew does it.
objections.response: Send me your last 3 reels — I'll edit one free this week so you can compare side by side before deciding.

objections.objection: ₹2,999/month is too much for me right now.
objections.response: Start with one ₹499 pilot reel, delivered in 48 hours; if it doesn't look better than your last post, you pay nothing more.

critic.verdict: This is a coherent, well-scoped service plan that fits a student founder's constraints: free tools, campus-first walk-ins, UPI payments, and a pilot-to-package funnel. Pricing at ₹499/₹2,999/₹5,999 is realistic for Dehradun cafes and undercuts the agency competitor the strategist identified. The main gap is whether 15 hours a week plus batchmate overflow can actually deliver 8 reels + 2 on-site shoots per Growth cafe without slipping the 48-hour promise.
critic.biggest_risk: Delivery load: if 4-6 cafes convert, the founder plus part-time batchmates must shoot, edit, caption and coordinate 16-30 reels/month within 15 hrs/week around classes — the 48-hour turnaround promise breaks first, and one late delivery to a small-town cafe owner likely churns the whole package.
